texts.spot: Hey there, Adventurer! It looks like you have discovered a new place that still isn’t on the map.
texts.gratefulForSharing: We are really glad that you decide to share your discovery with us.
texts.growingTheCommunity: We're super grateful you're sharing the coolest places for all of us. Every spot you share helps us grow stronger and more connected as a community.
texts.considerations: Here are some things you need to know before you proceed
texts.communityReview: Your newly discovery will be reviewd and confirmmed by the community.
texts.spotProgress: Keep an eye on the progress of your discovery in the app. Share it with your friends to have faster progress.
texts.toConfirmSpot: With 6 confirmations before time’s up, it’ll be officially on the map!
texts.encourageExploring: Keep exploring, keep sharing, and let’s make every nomad’s journey amazing together!
texts.provideSpotInformation: Please, provide us with the following information about the place you discovered.

generalInformation.title: General Information
generalInformation.message: Provide the following information about the place you discovered.

location.title: Location
location.message: Provide the following information about the location of the spot discovered. Have in mind, that you're current location will be used as the spot's location, so make sure be at the spot's location before submitting.
